subject: science
concept: Understanding pushes and pulls as forces that make objects move, stop, or change direction
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Forces and Motion) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student pushes and pulls real or virtual objects and observes the resulting motion
exercise.pictorial: Student labels pictured actions as a push or a pull
exercise.abstract: Student predicts what will happen to an object given a described push or pull

misconception_flags: confuses which direction a pulled object will move

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
